company.sign_in.description: Ask the User to sign in at a Company {company, account?, scopes?, new_account?} — to the account `account` labels, the only one held, else `default`: the task is the User's gate, closed when they have signed in on the Company's own page, and says how it ended. The configured User's alone

account.description: the label of the account it signs in to, once known

company.sign_out.description: Sign the User out of one account at a Company {company, account?} — the one `account` labels, or the only one held: its Account Token is revoked there and forgotten here, and every other account stays signed in. The configured User's alone
